title: Your first image: checkpoint, sampler, VAE
hook: Follow one prompt through checkpoint, text encoder, sampler and VAE: the shape of every hand-off, and the 20 sigma values that the sampler walks down, checked against the ComfyUI documentation.

verified.claim: CheckpointLoaderSimple returns MODEL, CLIP and VAE from one file.
KSampler defaults are 20 steps and cfg 8.0.
With denoise below 1, the list is built with int(steps / denoise) steps and the tail is kept.
At a cfg of 1 the negative is skipped.
The 20-step normal list matches the list printed in the documentation to four decimals.
verified.ref: docs.comfy.org/custom-nodes/backend/datatypes, checked by an assert in lab.py

verified.claim: The graph passes validate_prompt. The picture is from the Sampling Lab render set, one seed.

unchecked: The picture is one seed on one model, and it isn't a measurement of anything.
What a low denoise on an empty latent looks like was not rendered for this lesson.
